clues: This city sits on the west coast of a long thin land in south east Asia. It is tucked in a state that wraps all the way round it.
Wild storms strike this place again and again, all year long. Its broad vale sees more bursts of thunder and lightning than just about any place on Earth.
This town first grew up in the year 1857. It was built to serve the tin mines that lay all round it.
The tallest twin towers in the whole world stand here. Folks see their twin tops as a proud sign of the whole land.
The king of this land keeps his state home in this city. The men and women who make its laws meet here too.
